prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1253
Claimant:
Ashley Smith
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
2023-04-10
Claim received by phone from the claimant, who reports being hit on the driver side at an intersection while
proceeding through on a green light. Claimant is not represented by counsel and was advised of the claims process.
2023-04-12
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle is listed under coverage that was active at the time of
loss. Nothing in the policy records suggests the damage occurred before coverage began.
2023-05-07
Claimant provided photos of the vehicle from the scene. The images confirm some of the details described, though
they do not show the other vehicle's approach.
2023-08-31
Sent a field inspection request for the damaged vehicle. Inspector noted damage to the driver door, quarter panel,
and rear wheel area that is consistent with the described side impact.
2023-09-13
Spoke with the claimant again to clarify the sequence of events. The account matched the initial report in every detail,
including the direction of travel and the point of impact.
2023-09-21
Reviewed the inspector's photos. A few older scratches appear along the lower door panel and may predate this loss.
Will ask the appraiser to separate them from the new damage in the estimate.
2023-09-30
Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness beginning the day after the collision. A neck strain is a plausible injury for a
crash of this type. No prior injury to the neck or upper back has been reported or found in records checked so far.
2023-10-07
Claimant is seeing a provider and has begun a standard course of treatment. Reviewed the treatment notes, which
follow a usual course with symptoms easing as the calimant improved.
2023-10-25
Asked the claimant where they were seated at impact. The answer was not fully clear and the details given still leave
the seating position uncertain. Noted for follow-up.
2023-11-24
No independent witnesses have come forward. The claim file relies on the claimant's statements, the photos, and the
vehicle damage, which together are consistent with the reported impact.
2023-11-28
Based on the current file, the claim appears to be progressing normally. Will continue to monitor treatment progress,
complete the damage estimate, and follow up on the seating position questoin before final evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
